edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from [identify the dispute, including any case caption and number] (the “Dispute”). This Agreement becomes effective on the date of the last party’s signature (the “Effective Date”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [PROPOSED AMOUNT SUBJECT TO CLIENT APPROVAL; TO BE COMPLETED BEFORE EXECUTION] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Plaintiff shall provide wire instructions no later than two business days after the Effective Date. Defendant shall ensure that Plaintiff receives the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds no later than ten business days after the Effective Date, without deduction for transfer charges. Plaintiff expressly retains the right to enforce Defendant’s payment obligations under this Agreement. For purposes of this Agreement, “business day” means a day other than Saturday, Sunday, or a United States federal banking holiday.

2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds shall Plaintiff release Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute and based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the Effective Date. No release is effective before that receipt. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or to rights or obligations under this Agreement, including the right to enforce payment.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers, as required by law or legal process, or to the extent reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party disclosing terms to its advisers shall inform them of their confidential nature and instruct them to maintain confidentiality, subject to applicable legal and professional obligations.
